title: Crazy Taxi 2
owner_report: Played Crazy Taxi 2 and made a save; relaunching to load it stopped on the preparation screen (one photo).
first_session: Crazy Taxi 2 booted with the virtual A2 card through the post-hardware-init route, played and saved.

interpretation.filesystem: The SD card, its partition and the pair files were admitted; the stop happened inside session recovery.
interpretation.refusal: After journal recovery, kui_vmu_image_validate refused the 128 KiB card image (SESSION_IMAGE). The card that Crazy Taxi 2 had just saved to is not a consistent VMU filesystem under that check.
interpretation.open_question: Either Crazy Taxi 2 writes a shape the strict validator rejects, or a write was damaged. The RAM maps that chose the arena came from sessions in which the game could not save, so the save path's memory use was never observed.
interpretation.effect: Every game using this shared pair stops at preparation until the image is restored or explained.

requested: KUI/vmu-test/p0005 as it is now: card.vmd, card.journal, identity.bin and retail-persistent-profile-0005.bin
tools: tools/vmu_pair_inspect.c replays the journal with the production store into an in-memory copy and runs the production validator
tools/explain_vmu_image.py names every rule the effective image breaks and lists its files and FAT chains
